name: Kondou Ryuuichi
source:
A wealthy son of a distinguished family, Ryuuichi is a high achiever with excellent grades. He's a pefectionist, and hates to be second-best or leave things incomplete. Ryuuichi leads the school council as its president with great responsibility and wisdom. He likes comic haiku, and is sure to read at least one after school. He is the Blue Hotokenser.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.twofive.co.jp/hotokenser/chara/ryuichi.html]official website[/URL].]
